AgentSafeCapabilityExtensionV1.description:
Rust-owned LLP 0162 §8 capability extension. Its public constructors are
deliberately Missing-only until a later digest-bound publication carrier
supplies a validated candidate for one named target.

@ref LLP 0162#8-capability-honesty — target support and app-effective
coverage are separate, every class is closed, and specialized lane gaps
remain visible without silently widening the core aggregate.

AgentSafeCapabilityFactsV1.description:
One projection of the component and aggregate facts. The target projection
reports installed and qualified machinery; `appEffective` separately
reports what the current app actually exercises.

AgentSafeCapabilitySchemaVersion.description:
Version discriminator for the orthogonal agent-safe storage fact block.
This is intentionally independent of [`TargetCapabilityId`]: class facts
are multi-valued observations, not boolean support-registry membership.

AgentSafeEnvelopeCoverageByAdapterV1.description:
Fixed durable-lane inventory. Specialized lanes remain first-class facts
even though their absence does not block the v1 core aggregate.

AgentSafeEnvelopeCoverageByScopeV1.description:
Exact logical-lane x physical-adapter coverage. The ordinary and Host
namespaces each have both execution adapters; collapsing either axis would
let one green writer silently stand in for another.

AgentSafeExplanationFactsV1.description:
Canonical sparse projection of explanation support. An empty list is the
complete Missing projection. Positive entries are strictly scope-sorted,
unique, and use only the closed profile/access/execution vocabulary above.

AgentSafeForkEgressV1.description:
@ref LLP 0158#capability-registry-record — positive derived-fork axes use
the exact lower-camel spellings bound by the publication candidate.

AgentsManifest.description:
App policy for creating new agent principals. Absence is deliberately
equivalent to `disabled` rather than opening an ambient signup surface.

@ref LLP 0055#registration — registration is sessions-only, disabled by
default, and user invitations require an explicit `invitedBy` opt-in.

ApiAskManifest.description:
Host-managed near-data AI surface. `model.secret` is a declaration name,
never secret material; caller-key material exists only for one request.

@ref LLP 0204#d5--surface-4-the-near-data-ai-interface — ask is opt-in,
  names who pays, and reuses LLP 0036 declarations for app-paid keys.

ApiFunctionApproval.description:
Approval posture for externally reachable durable effects.

`required` gates every caller. `external` preserves direct first-party
session calls while gating service-principal, integration, and link lanes.

ApiManifest.description:
App-owned declaration of the outward-facing function surface. Absence (or
`enabled: false`) preserves the existing first-party/grant behavior; when
enabled, every function is closed unless its named entry opts in.

@ref LLP 0204#d1--the-exposure-declaration-keystone — exposure is one
declaration governing callability and public projections.

ApiOAuthManifest.description:
Standards-interoperability projection over the native LLP 0150 ceremony.
Bundle names are the public OAuth scope vocabulary; activation resolves
their function names to the same stable id/kind pairs used by grants.

@ref LLP 0204#d8--authority-acquisition-the-ceremony-and-the-facade — the
  generated facade has no independent authority and bearer is an explicit
  per-app weakening.
@ref LLP 0204#open-questions — OQ3 selects named bundles compiled at
  activation rather than exposing canonical grant scopes as OAuth strings.

AppCliTargetFactsV1.description:
The `app-cli.target` eligibility descriptor (LLP 0062 §4; dated LLP 0058
amendment 2026-08-01).

Deliberately a **structured descriptor**, not a ninth entry in the closed
`TargetCapabilityId` string set: §4 requires a target to state *which*
principal classes it supports, whether it serves envelopes and accepts
generation assertions, and the per-grant token cap the engine's admission
bound must read rather than hardcode. A boolean could carry none of that.

Absence is the honest capability-absent report — §4's rule that the engine
"never infers any of this from a URL" has teeth only because this fact
exists to read. Facts state what the target *supports*; they never prove
transport locality, which is why the agent lane's loopback condition stays
engine-enforced.

acceptsGenerationAssertions.description:
Whether the target admits caller-asserted `expectedGeneration`
(LLP 0012's call-time binding).

capabilityId.description: The working capability id this descriptor answers for.

perGrantTokenCap.description:
The per-grant live-token cap the engine's cross-process admission
bound reads. `None` where the target admits no agent lane — a
hardcoded copy of LLP 0055's constant would drift silently.

principalClasses.description:
Closed principal-class vocabulary this target admits, from §4's
matrix: `anonymous`, `dev`, `session`, `agent`. A class the target
refuses is simply absent — the engine reports the refusal as a target
capability rather than a bug.

servesEnvelopes.description: Whether the target composes and serves `/app-api/*` envelopes.

AppIdentity.description: Optional presentation identity for the loaded app: how the instance should introduce itself to a human. Everything here is public by construction — it is rendered on the public root page and flows into the public inspect projection — so apps must not put secrets in it. The icon/wordmark URLs are ordinary app-served or absolute URLs; the root page renders them as plain `` references with attribute escaping. @ref LLP 0017#instance-home-page — the root page renders this identity when the manifest declares it; absent, the page is Snapback-branded only.

ArtifactVersion.description:
A schema/function artifact version understood by the auth-aware receiver.
Capability manifests report the dimensions separately for discovery, but
[`SupportedArtifactAuthPair`] remains the actual compatibility authority.

AssetExportFactsV1.description:
Consistent-cut export/import facts: cut export and import validation are
implemented claims; `import_apply` stays `"experimental"` until the
restore epoch machinery graduates (the flag-gated posture). Byte-level
snapshot backup remains a `missing` entry — this block claims the
logical cut only.

AssetImageFactsV1.description:
The declared image-processing facts (LLP 0044 §Declarative processing;
the `asset-image-finalization` fact carried by the pipeline composite).
Every ceiling here is `Enforced` on the declaring target — the values are
single-sourced from `assets_image::ASSET_IMAGE_CEILINGS_LOCAL_V1`.

onDemandWidthLadder.description:
The bounded on-demand width ladder (LLP 0044 §Ceremony floor,
2026-08-01): `?width=N` normalizes up this ladder and materializes
once through the ordinary rendition machinery.

AssetReferenceGcFactsV1.description:
The reference-GC facts block (LLP 0044 §Capability facts: the
`asset-reference-gc-v1` target support, distinct from the app's
schema-level opt-in that actually enables the sweep).

AssetReferenceGcPolicyV1.description:
The app's reference-GC opt-in: a ready asset with no typed
reverse-reference edges is reclaimed after this grace period. Codegen
refuses a grace outside the target's declared Enforced bounds.

AssetSharingManifest.description:
The closed asset-sharing declaration, reusing the shipped visibility
union rather than a not-yet-implemented general permission language.

AssetTargetFactsV1.description:
The declared asset target facts (LLP 0044 §Capability facts; LLP 0012
dated registration 2026-07-31). The lifecycle claim is store-parameterized
— `lifecycle_stores` is part of the claim, and the v1 nonclaims are
reported Missing here, never omitted.

advisoryLimits.description:
Every listed limit above is `Enforced` on this target; a limit a
target cannot enforce must move to this graded list instead of
silently keeping the field.

export.description:
Consistent-cut export/import (LLP 0044, dated design addition
2026-07-31): what this target proves. `None` is the honest Missing
report.

image.description:
The image-processing facts block; `None` is the honest Missing
report for a target without `asset-image-finalization`.

lifecycleCallbacks.description:
Lifecycle-callback events the target can deliver (dev-lane only in
v1; a sessions-mode schema refuses callback declarations at
generation).

maxChunkBytes.description:
Per-file byte bounds are intent-declared facts, not a target
ceiling; the transfer chunk bound is the target's.

maxGrantsPerApp.description:
Defaults for backward parsing of pre-grant capability manifests; new
local manifests always emit the enforced ceiling explicitly.

missing.description:
LLP 0044's explicit v1 nonclaims, reported Missing rather than
omitted: the manifest never implies them.

referenceGc.description:
Reference-tracked asset GC support (LLP 0044 §Deletion, opt-in):
`None` is the honest Missing report; the bounds are Enforced —
a schema-declared grace outside them refuses at generation.

seedAssetFixtures.description:
Seed binary fixtures (LLP 0109 §17): idempotent
`asset.ensureSeedFixture` ingestion plus placeholder resolution in
the install transaction. `false` is the honest Missing report.

signedUrlDefaultTtlMs.description:
`private-signed` issuance TTLs: the default applied when a request
names none, and the declared maximum a request may not exceed.

video.description:
The video-processing facts block; `None` is the honest Missing
report for a target without `asset-video-finalization`.

AssetVideoFactsV1.description:
The declared video-processing facts (LLP 0044 §Generated upload intents:
the `asset-video-finalization` fact). Strip is box-structure surgery,
never transcoding; every ceiling is `Enforced`, single-sourced from
`assets_video::ASSET_VIDEO_CEILINGS_LOCAL_V1`.

containerBrands.description:
Container brands the strip rewrite classifies; other brands refuse
under strip rather than passing unclassified metadata through.

AuthManifest.description:
Closed schema-manifest auth declaration. Unknown members are rejected so a
future authority-changing field cannot be silently ignored by this parser.

AuthMode.description:
The authority mode declared by a schema artifact. The enum is deliberately
closed: a mode changes who is allowed to supply invocation authority and an
unknown spelling therefore cannot be treated as an additive field.

@ref LLP 0058#closed-auth-mode — auth mode is a must-understand closed value.

AuthPasswordIdentifierMode.description:
App-declared canonicalization contract for local-password identities.
The catalog stores the versioned value on first activation and refuses a
contradictory declaration thereafter.

AuthProtocols.description: Version-1 auth protocol numbers reported by an auth-aware target.

AuthRequirement.description:
Function-level requirement applied after caller authority has been resolved.
Absence in a legacy function is represented by
[`FunctionDefinition::effective_auth_requirement`] as `optional-user`.

@ref LLP 0058#closed-function-requirement — closed values fail at manifest parse.

AuthorityProfileIdentityV1.description:
Stable identity of one authority-profile generation. Function manifests
carry this beside their ordinary authorization dimensions so a role-field
or transition edit is visible to dependent artifact review without
changing the evaluator's existing membership predicate shape.

coarseGlobalWakeUniverse.description:
The conservative target universe when a consumer cannot qualify the
exact `(principal, scope)` invalidation path. This is metadata only in
rollout 1; no new wake behavior is installed here.

AuthorityProfileV1.description:
The closed rollout-1 authority profile projection. Canonical membership
remains in [`TableManifest::membership`] and table policy remains in
[`TableManifest::visibility`]; reference fields below make that ownership
explicit while carrying the profile-only lattice, identity, and
qualification facts codegen needs to explain.

@ref LLP 0240#d2-compile-one-authority-ir-for-read-and-write-decisions —
  one generated projection feeds the already-shipped policy vocabulary.
@ref LLP 0225#1-ownership-map — this cross-owner value shape lives in the
  manifest leaf; storage/evaluators consume only their existing carriers.

AuthorizationInputDimension.description:
Closed caller-authority dimensions that a query result may depend on.
Retention v1 accepts `userId` plus the effective principal `kind`, which is
an immutable function of that identity; spelling the rejected dimensions
is still important because a manifest must describe why it is online-only
rather than silently erasing actor/session/provider/opaque dependence.

@ref LLP 0053#retained-and-offline-authorization — retained rows survive a
  same-user session replacement, so every other authority dimension is
  deliberately ineligible.

BoundedSkewDeclaration.description:
Capture-time identity of one proposed bounded-skew declaration. Ticket 05
adds manifest admission and execution semantics; ticket 02 makes changes
fail closed under a reused mutation id immediately.

BrowserCredentialPosture.description:
The strongest browser credential claim the target can honestly advertise.

A restrictive CSP does not upgrade bearer v1: app-origin script can still
read or exercise the coordinator's IndexedDB/page-memory credential.

agentSafe.description:
Versioned LLP 0162 fact projection. This remains present and wholly
`Missing` until a named target passes its component corpus and a later
publication carrier validates and installs the candidate facts.

appCliTarget.description:
The `app-cli.target` eligibility descriptor (LLP 0062 §4; dated LLP
0058 amendment 2026-08-01). Absence is capability-absent: the engine
refuses credentialed lanes rather than inferring eligibility from a
URL or a correlated capability.

assets.description:
Declared asset facts (LLP 0044; LLP 0012 dated registration
2026-07-31). Presence with a qualified store list is half the
`asset_lifecycle_v1` predicate; absence is the honest Missing report
for targets without the subsystem.

capabilityMaturity.description:
Maturity annotations over `supportedCapabilities` (LLP 0058
§Capability maturity, amendment 2026-07-24). Only emitted ids whose
registry maturity is not `stable` appear here; an id absent from this
map is stable, and a manifest omitting the field predates the maturity
dimension. The map is derived from the same closed Rust registry as
`supportedCapabilities` — it is reporting, never accepted as authority
from a posted artifact.

connectedClientPredicate.description:
Advisory connected-client predicate facts. `single-authority-routing`
means every relevant client act and handler must reach this exact app
authority; multi-instance targets may not infer aggregation from it.

expoPushSeam.description:
Local Expo integration-seam facts. This is deliberately distinct from
the first-class `notifications` capability owned by LLP 0045.
Presence reports target support; use still requires a session-auth app
declaration and an instance with outbound actions enabled.

fullTextSearch.description:
Exact local portable-search posture. Absent on Cloudflare,
conformance, and hosted targets until their independent corpus
qualifies.

hostedAuth.description:
Target-authored deployment and browser-security facts. App artifacts
and operator input may consume this descriptor but cannot assert it.

@ref LLP 0060#d5-hosted-readiness-is-conjunctive — hosted auth is an
exact conjunction; local loopback and production profile are not facts.

liveFullTextSearch.description:
Closed target-owned facts for LLP 0136 live search. This block is
absent on every current target while `live_full_text_search_v1`
remains unpublished; parent search/live facts are never substituted.

migration.description:
Migration-executor facts (LLP 0081 §4): the executor profile and
the closed fence lane registry. Present exactly when the target has
a migration executor; absent targets refuse with
`SNAPBACK_MIGRATION_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE`.

packagedStoreQualificationMode.description:
Instance-live bootstrap marker for the staged packaged-store
qualification corpus. Absence/false is the only production posture.

relationalQueries.description:
Relational-query facts (LLP 0080 §4): the live delivery class and
the closed set of admitted retention classes. Present exactly when
the target supports `relational_query_v1`; a target without the
executor reports the capability gap instead.

runtimeFacts.description:
Target-computed runtime facts (LLP 0048 §Single-sourced runtime flags,
DK-5 capability truthfulness): the workerd release id, pinned
compatibility date and flags, kill-domain shape, and computed limit
values. Absent on targets that assert their limits statically.

standardPatterns.description:
Generated standard-pattern facts (LLP 0065 §4): live delivery is the
conservative resnapshot, and the `authScopeField`-enabled
disjointness-skip refinement of LLP 0053 is disabled — the field is
invalidation-routing metadata, never a skip enabler or enforcement.
Present exactly when the target runs generated standard patterns.

vectorSearch.description:
Closed exact-vector facts. Present on the qualified local target and
absent everywhere that reports the structured `vector_search_v1` GAP.

vmLifecycle.description:
VM lifecycle for handler execution. Current targets report
`"fresh-per-invocation"`; `"warm-pooled-reset"` remains a recognized
historical value for compatibility with older artifacts. Surfaced so
LLP 0012's honesty rule holds.

@ref LLP 0009#dk-4-retired--upstream-ibex-owner-thread-contract-2026-07-27 — lifecycle truthfulness.

CapabilityMaturity.description:
The closed maturity vocabulary for registry capability ids (LLP 0058
§Capability maturity, amendment 2026-07-24; LLP 0074's no-overclaim rule
for Draft authorities).

- `proposed`: the contract exists in a proposal document but no
  implementation is registered; a proposed id is never emitted in
  `supportedCapabilities` at all.
- `experimental`: the implementation is registered and the id's positive
  instance predicate holds, but the governing contract is not Accepted —
  the entry asserts current-contract compatibility only, and admission
  refuses requirements on it unless the requiring artifact explicitly
  acknowledges the experimental contract.
- `stable`: the original LLP 0058 reading — positive presence is the
  plain compatibility assertion.

ConnectedClientPredicateFactsV2.description: Machine-readable semantics for LLP 0222's advisory connectivity fact.

scopeContract.description:
Frozen generated scope/value contracts retained for prepared clients.
The server's existing request validators remain authoritative.

@ref LLP 0107#public-api — prepared React bindings admit the complete
generated/deployed collection schema rather than reconstructing it.

ExpoPushSeamFactsV1.description:
Machine-readable honesty and operating bounds for LLP 0143's local Expo
provider seam. These are target facts, not app-supplied declarations.

oneOf.description:
A closed, declaration-ordered domain of two through eight exact string
values. The authored order is part of manifest identity and generated
TypeScript projection; storage remains the ordinary portable text
representation.

@ref LLP 0004#dated-alignment-stored-literal-union-domains-2026-08-08

One closed, schema-declared plain-data value stored as RFC 8785
canonical JSON text. Its interior is intentionally opaque to indexes,
filters, ordering, matchers, search, and maintained projections.

The externally tagged variant keeps the carrier physically inside the
field manifest, so both `contractHash` and `contract.encoding` enter
schema/storage-generation identity.

@ref LLP 0211#declaration-closed-dispatch-closed-interior — only the
  closed structured-position leaf profile may reach this variant.

`v.principal()` — nominal typing over the auth-principal id string space
(the same space as `ctx.auth.userId`, including LLP 0055 agent
principals). It stores and compares exactly like [`FieldType::String`];
the distinct variant lets the schema surface *name* an axis as a
principal reference. It is validated by **shape**, never by a
foreign-key existence check, because memberships may outlive a
principal's deactivation and LLP 0055 recovery preserves the id.

@ref LLP 0056#declaring-a-membership-table — `v.principal()` is nominal
  typing over the principal-id string space, not an existence check.

`v.id("table")` — a nominal application-table id. The value remains a
string on SQLite and the public wire, while the target table travels in
the manifest so membership resource bindings and helper arguments can
be checked rather than inferred from a bare string.

@ref LLP 0056#rule-helpers — resource references must name the same
  declared resource type; a plain string cannot prove that equality.

Framework-owned relation-incarnation stamp. It is stored as a string,
but unlike an application string it is never writable by application
arguments. The paired required foreign-key field is the complete
relationship declaration.

@ref LLP 0110#protected-relation-incarnation-and-stamping — central
  writers overwrite the stamp from the active parent registry.

`v.assetRef({ upload? })` — a typed asset reference (LLP 0044 §Typed
references; LLP 0007 dated amendment 2026-07-31). Stored as the opaque
asset id string; the commit boundary validates every write's
admission, so a raw string assignment fails there rather than by
shape. The optional `upload` restriction names the upload-intent
binding whose assets the field admits and is what lets write paths
without handler execution derive a commit-boundary admission.

FunctionArgsContract.description:
One closed object contract over a function's declared arguments:
declaration-ordered fields, each carrying a value node from the same node
vocabulary the result manifest uses (LLP 0131 — one node vocabulary, two
contract roots).

HistoryRetentionManifestV1.description:
Finite product-history retention declared beside the table it governs.
This is authoring authority; storage projects it into the durable policy
table in the same transaction that publishes the schema manifest.

unique.description:
A true unique index. It is total when all key fields are required and
unique-where-present when `where_applicable` is set.

@ref LLP 0056#declaring-a-membership-table — the generated membership
  index is true-unique; today's `IndexManifest` had no uniqueness flag.

whereApplicable.description:
The portable unique-where-present profile. Every key component must be
non-null for a row to participate; the carrier states this explicitly
instead of asking adapters to infer it from field declarations.

@ref LLP 0007#index-contract — optional unique keys use the all-present
  compound rule and target partial unique indexes.

LiveAuthorityLaneStats.description: Fail-closed authority-lane work and final-publication gate outcomes.

quarantineEntries.description:
Live subscription scopes whose first active quarantine-or-worse
obligation was raised. Re-fire and revision merge do not re-enter.

quarantineExits.description:
Quarantine-or-worse subscription obligations discharged by the exact
revision-bound acknowledgement of an accepted resolution.

LiveCoalesceStats.description: Cumulative coalescing counters reported on the serialized inspect surface.

backstopFlushes.description:
Pending subscription turns performed by the serving backstop task.
Single-commit turns count here but not as coalesced flushes.

coalescedFlushes.description:
Scheduler turns that delivered pending data merged from more than one
commit, by either the serving task or the synchronous embedder drain.

deferredCommits.description: Commit frames whose data fan-out was deferred into the pending frame.

lastFlushMergedFrames.description:
Number of accepted pending commit frames represented by the most
recent scheduler turn. A bound-triggered refresh collapse is one unit.

authorizationBlastRadius.description:
The deliberately coarse v1 authorization blast radius, reported both
globally and against each stable membership declaration that caused an
event. These are cumulative runtime-epoch counters; delivery-frame
counters above retain their existing reset semantics.

@ref LLP 0056#invalidation-the-llp-0053-mapping -- make membership churn's global
  quarantine cost measurable before declaration-scoped narrowing.

resume.description:
RQS resume/refresh observability (LLP 0090 §Scalability: counters land
with rollout step 1). Cumulative runtime-epoch counters.

LiveEvaluationStats.description: Scheduler evaluation lifecycle and wire-output accounting.

LiveFullTextSearchFactsV1.description:
The exact inspection fact block a future claiming target must publish.
Values are target facts, not app-authored authority. The sibling stays
absent while support is false, but landing the closed shape now prevents
the runtime wave from inventing a looser or backend-specific projection.

@ref LLP 0136#capability-id-and-claim-discipline-llp-0119-oq2-proposal

LiveMatcherDecisionStats.description:
Permanent matcher-decision ledger. Every subscription disposition is
classified once into one of these four OQ4-compatible lanes.

LiveSettlementStats.description: Commit-ack to caller-settlement decomposition for applied mutations.

LiveWatermarkStats.description: Standalone convergence-envelope production and latest-value collapse.

MaintenanceDiagnostics.description:
Closed, monotonic maintenance health facts. Error text and room identities
stay in the gated diagnostic ring; this projection is safe for public
inspection and sufficient to distinguish healthy retry from a persistent
maintenance failure.

MembershipExpiry.description:
`expiry: { field, onExpiry }` — a time-bounded membership materialized by
the host-bound sweep. In v1 the only `onExpiry` effect is `remove`: with no
declared role ordering the host cannot prove any downgrade is
non-escalating, so a `downgradeTo:` effect is a manifest error.

@ref LLP 0056#writes-a-declared-transition-policy-closed-by-default — remove-only
  in v1; the host owns the rollback-checked sweep.

onExpiry.description:
The declared expiry effect. v1 accepts exactly `"remove"`; any other
spelling (e.g. `"downgradeTo:guest"`) is refused by `validate_schema`.

MembershipLastHolder.description:
`lastHolder: { protect: <role> }` — the protected role's *eligible* holder
set may never be left empty for any live resource. Schema activation
validates the declaration and existing rows; the write path preserves the
invariant with commit-time concurrency checks.

@ref LLP 0056#writes-a-declared-transition-policy-closed-by-default — the
  protected role never empties; establishment requires `bootstrapRole == R`.

MembershipManifest.description:
The `.membership()` metadata carried by a [`TableManifest`]. See
`crate::storage`'s `validate_schema` for the declaration-shape enforcement
and `validate_membership_activation` for the fail-closed scan over existing
data.

The public authoring path emits this exact shape from `.membership()`,
including nominal `v.principal()` / `v.id(table)` axes. Schema activation
validates existing rows and installs the generated indexes; the host then
enforces transition writes, declaration-bound reads, invalidation, and
provenance below every app writer.

@ref LLP 0056#declaring-a-membership-table — the recognized membership
  shape and its closed, non-null, exact-decoded vocabulary.

bootstrapRole.description:
The role the creation witness seats. Required to equal `lastHolder`'s
protected role when `lastHolder` is declared.

id.description:
Stable declaration id. Absent means it defaults from the table name
(see [`MembershipManifest::effective_id`]); pin it with `id:` to keep a
durable reference stable across a table rename.

incidental.description:
Attested non-authorization columns. Subject to a hard floor: the
principal/resource/role axes and generated provenance columns can never
be attested incidental.

pendingRoles.description:
Pending roles — in the write vocabulary but excluded from `memberOf`.
Disjoint from `roles`; their union is the closed write vocabulary.

principal.description: Name of the non-null principal-axis field (`v.principal()`).

principalAddressedWrites.description:
Explicit opt-in to principal-addressed writes (LLP 0100 §2). Absent
means the generated `removePrincipal` surface does not exist for this
declaration; presence requires at least one total other-principal
removal transition at activation. Closed: v1 admits only
`{ remove: true }`.

resource.description: Name of the non-null resource-axis field. Absent iff `scope: "app"`.

resourceTable.description:
The resource table the `resource` axis references (`v.id("events")`).
Present for `scope: "resource"`; absent for `scope: "app"`. Used by the
activation scan's referential-integrity check. Codegen derives it from
the nominal `v.id(...)` resource-axis declaration; direct manifests are
still validated against the same binding.

role.description: Name of the non-null role field.

transitions.description:
The closed transition matrix. Shape-validated at manifest load and
executed at the central membership write seam.

MembershipOp.description:
The op a transition governs. The manifest loader shape-validates it, and
the host evaluates the matrix with caller-class derivation, target binding,
and witness capture at the central membership write seam.

MembershipPrincipalAddressedWrites.description:
`principalAddressedWrites: { remove: true }` — the closed opt-in for the
generated principal-addressed removal command (LLP 0100 §2). The object
is closed and v1 admits only `remove: true`: false, unknown operations,
and unknown fields fail activation, and no principal-addressed `setRole`,
`patch`, or read is implied.

@ref LLP 0100#2-opting-into-principal-addressed-removal — activation
  additionally requires at least one total other-principal removal
  transition, and under `lastHolder` every carrier caller role must be
  the protected role (the hidden-role-oracle closure).

MembershipProvenance.description:
The two host-filled attribution levels. `authorityCreating` (LLP 0055)
requires `full`. Schema validation enforces the `incidental` floor over
the generated provenance columns; the membership writer fills those
columns and records the append-only transition log.

@ref LLP 0056#agents — creation attribution vs. the append-only transition
  log; `full` is `authorityCreating`'s precondition.

MembershipScope.description:
The scope a membership declaration binds its `resource` axis to.

@ref LLP 0056#global-roles — a `resource`-scoped declaration references one
  resource table; `app` scope is the degenerate global-role case whose
  resource is a system-constant singleton (never a null column).

oneOf.description: The declared `resource` column references exactly one resource table.

The whole app is the resource (classic global RBAC as the degenerate
case). There is no `resource` column; uniqueness is one row per
principal per declaration.

MembershipTarget.description: Whether a transition acts on the caller's own row or another principal's.

oneOf.description: The effective principal **is** the target row's principal ("self").

MembershipTransition.description:
One row of the closed, declaration-level transition matrix (`op` × caller
class × self/other × `from`→`to`, or `patch` × `fields`). Manifest loading
**shape-validates** every entry — chiefly that no unknown role hides in
`by`/`from`/`to` and no undeclared column hides in `fields`, so the closed
vocabulary holds. The runtime evaluates this same matrix for every
declaration-bound membership write.

@ref LLP 0056#writes-a-declared-transition-policy-closed-by-default — the
  policy is declared, closed by default, and enforced by the host.

by.description:
Caller classes: a declared role, or the reserved classes `"self"` /
`"none"`.

fields.description: Non-axis, non-role columns a `patch` transition may write.

MigrationTargetFacts.description:
The migration-executor posture and the closed lane registry the
persisted migration fence covers (LLP 0081 §4): a lane the fence does
not name cannot be admitted at all, so the registry is a capability
fact, not prose.

executor.description:
The executor profile: `"local-exclusive-single-writer"` on the
local target (one IMMEDIATE transaction per durable transition).

fenceLanes.description: The closed, enumerated lane registry the durable fence closes.

PublicConfigEntryDefinition.description:
Public config declaration. Values never ride the manifest; the source span
is additionally removed because it reveals local build paths.

PublicCronInspectState.description:
Public cron posture: aggregate state only. Run records, result values,
error messages, diagnostic details, run ids, and slot/idempotency keys stay
on the gated administrative inspect surface because handler-controlled text
can contain credentials or application data.

PublicCronJobDefinition.description: Public cron declaration: scheduling posture without its source path.

PublicDiagnostic.description:
Public diagnostic identity. Messages and structured details can contain
source paths, handler text, arguments, or other operator-only context, so
unauthenticated inspection exposes only the stable classification fields.

PublicEphemeralDiagnostics.description:
Aggregate ephemeral health facts safe for unauthenticated inspection.
Per-room identities, routing keys, scopes, and epochs stay on the gated
admin endpoint because they can encode tenant and application data.

PublicFunctionDefinition.description:
Public projection of [`FunctionDefinition`]: everything except the
executable runtime body and the source span.

argsContract.description:
The declared argument contract (LLP 0131) — a bounded declarative
schema like the result contract, safe on the public projection.

id.description:
Always present: the validated manifest guarantees a non-empty stable
id, so the public projection never serves a null function identity.

publicInline.description:
LLP 0092 §0C.3 disclosure fact — already disclosed by the behavior it
authorizes, so it rides the public projection.

rqsEligible.description:
LLP 0092 §0C.2 derived predicate — never authored; clients key the
alias-key promotion check and token expectations on it.

PublicFunctionManifest.description:
The public projection of [`FunctionManifest`] served inside the root
`/inspect` identity descriptor. Like `PublicInspect` it is a typed
allowlist: the `From` impls below destructure the full structs exhaustively,
so a newly-added field is a compile error here rather than a silent leak.

What it keeps: identity/compat and dependency facts — app id, bundle/inputs
hashes, function names/kinds/capability summaries, read/write summaries,
cron and config *declarations* (never values; secrets do not ride the
manifest — LLP 0036). What it drops: every executable handler body
(`IbexModule.source`, `HandlerPlan` step bodies), every function/cron/config
`sourceSpan` (a source-path leak), and free-form unsupported-dependency
diagnostic message/details. Full operational context stays only on the gated
`/_snapback/api/inspect` twin.

@ref LLP 0031#resolved-decisions — D3: public `/inspect` is an identity
  descriptor; handler source and plan bodies are operational facts for the
  gated twin only (ENG-23441).

PublicFunctionRuntime.description:
Public projection of [`FunctionRuntime`]: the runtime kind (and the export
name for Ibex modules) without any executable body.

PublicHostPlanKind.description: Which host-plan family a redacted `HostPlan` runtime executes.

PublicIbexModule.description: Public projection of [`IbexModule`]: the export name, never the source.

PublicRuntimeCapabilities.description:
Runtime capability posture safe for unauthenticated inspection. Absolute
executable/submodule paths remain on the gated inspect endpoint.

PublicSchemaManifest.description:
Public schema identity facts. The schema itself is intentionally public,
but artifact diagnostics are projected to their stable classification so
source paths and application values in producer-authored text stay gated.

PublicStorageInfo.description: Public storage facts: the change version and table list, never the on-disk path.

PublicSubscriptionInfo.description: Public subscription facts: id and function, never the owning connection id.

PushAudienceAuthorizeV1.description:
Host-enforced send authorization. Membership checks are evaluated against
the resolved caller at execution; `system` is an explicit declaration,
never an inference from a cron/job action.

PushAudienceResolverV1.description:
The closed v1 resolver vocabulary: all current rows of one LLP 0100
membership declaration, optionally narrowed to declared roles.

liveDelivery.description:
Always `"live_replace"` in v1: relational subscriptions inherit
LLP 0053 with table-granular invalidation and no proved-disjoint
skip, and no incremental delta matcher is admitted.

retention.description:
Closed, default-deny retention classes the target admits for
relational plans: `none` (the default) and
`opaque-authorized-snapshot-v1` (the authenticated lease class) and
`result-transform-snapshot-v1` (the owner-reclassified post-gate
class). Both retained classes require owner-visible plans; anonymous
results have no admissible retention.

ResultValueContract.description:
The schema-expanded value grammar used to validate handler results at the
Rust publication boundary.

@ref LLP 0108#final-author-reconciliation-after-round-3 — result contracts
are Rust-owned, bounded, and carried by every generated function.

oneOf.description:
A typed asset reference in a handler result. Its post-JSON wire image
is the non-empty opaque asset id string; attachment authority remains
a storage-commit concern rather than an egress-shape concern.
The same-snapshot projection of one distinguished media field.

A declaration-ordered heterogeneous fixed tuple. Snapshot-batch uses
this closed node so each visible child page keeps its own projection
contract instead of being widened to a homogeneous array.

@ref LLP 0135#23-seal-entirely-partial-refusal — visible composite
  nodes are an exact static tuple, not a bag of widened values.

One exact fixed-dimension binary64 vector. This is intentionally not
encoded as an ordinary array: dimensions may reach 4,096 while the
general collection node remains capped at 1,024.

@ref LLP 0132#the-vvectordimensions-value

A reference to an entry in the closed, platform-owned registry of
exported Rust-owned schemas. Valid only at argument positions in v1;
not an app-authorable spelling — `defineSearchQuery` constructs it
internally and no `v.*` builder emits it. The node contributes its
authority class and reference id (never the referenced artifact's
bytes) to the canonical hash form; artifact drift is gated by the
schema-export drift test. The explicit `authority` member is a closed
enum with exactly one admitted value in v1, so a future app-schema
reference (option E) is a distinct authority class with
digest-carrying identity rather than a silent reinterpretation.

@ref LLP 0131#the-argument-contract-descriptor — PlatformSchemaRef is
the one new node kind; v1's registry has exactly
`snapback:search-query-ast:v1`.

scopeFields.description: Exact room-scope field → backing-table field mapping.

RqsResumeStats.description:
Resume attempted/admitted/refused (by per-cause `SNAPBACK_RESUME_*` code),
rung taken, journal distance, and token refresh overhead.

deltaReplayAnswers.description:
Rung-2 delta-replay answers (LLP 0090 D1.3 / rollout step 6): the
witness verified and a `live_delta` answered the resume.

freshReplaceAnswers.description: Token presented, answered with rung 3 (refusal or no available proof).

lastJournalDistance.description: Journal distance (head − token version) of the last presented token.

mintRefusals.description: Rows/args the 0A canonicalization refused at mint (`resume` absent).

noCertifiedSummary.description:
Rung-1 table-set fall-throughs: journal floor held but no certified
dependency-summary artifact exists yet (cluster 0C), so the answer is
rung 3. Not a token refusal — its own telemetry cause.

replayBytesAvoided.description:
Estimated bytes avoided by rung-2 answers versus a rung-3
replacement: serialized replacement rows minus the serialized delta
envelope, saturating at zero per answer.

replayOps.description: Total `live_delta` ops replayed by rung-2 answers.

tokensMinted.description: Tokens minted on the live path (subscribe answers + envelope refresh).

SchemaRefAuthority.description:
The closed authority classes a schema-reference node may name. V1 admits
exactly `platform`; hash-by-reference-id is a property of this class.

fieldClassifications.description:
Closed classification carrier for every participating field that is
not already classified by `text_fields`.

SequenceExistingOwnerAccess.description:
Generated-plan access proof. The function's normalized
`write-with-activity.v1` plan must carry the same scope table, owner field,
scope expression, and parent-unavailable refusal before this profile is
admitted; handlers cannot author this variant.

SequenceScopeAccess.description:
One declared sequence counter and the structural proof that an invocation
may observe its allocation count. `public.v1` is deliberately a string on
the wire because it is the reviewed disclosure spelling pinned by LLP
0135; non-public access names the membership declaration and exact roles
the host evaluates against the supplied scope row.

authScopeDisjointnessSkip.description:
Always `"disabled"` in v1: `authScopeField` routes invalidation and
never enables LLP 0053's disjointness-skip refinement, so no
convergence fixture is owed until a future profile claims the skip.

liveDelivery.description:
Always `"conservative-resnapshot"` in v1: a generated live query
resnapshots on a dependency commit and never claims `live_delta` —
the runtime excludes pattern-identified functions from the delta
lane even when the plan shape would otherwise qualify.

StoredStructuredContractV1.description:
The persisted logical descriptor and physical encoding identity for one
typed opaque structured field.

@ref LLP 0211#representation-and-write-path — the complete recursive
  descriptor is durable validation authority; the encoding id is a
  separately versioned storage-generation input.

SupportedArtifactAuthPair.description:
One explicitly supported schema/function-version and auth-mode tuple.
Separate version/mode arrays are dimension reports and never imply a
Cartesian-product authorization.

@ref LLP 0058#the-two-admissible-tuples — exactly v0+dev and v1+sessions.

assetSharing.description:
`.assetSharing(spec)` — the explicit declaration that this table's
analyzable row-visibility policy is sufficient asset-sharing
authority: anyone the spec admits may also read assets referenced
from these rows. Without it a typed reference confers no
`via-references` read authority (owner-only fallback).

@ref LLP 0044#asset-read-authorization — sharing is never inferred
  from a filter's existence; LLP 0007 dated amendment 2026-07-31
  freezes the closed spelling.

authorityProfile.description:
Rollout-1 projection of `.authorityProfile(...)`. This is a versioned
authoring/codegen fact over the canonical membership and table-policy
declarations; it adds no evaluator or independently writable roster.

@ref LLP 0240#d1-declare-an-application-authority-profile-at-the-scoped-relation
  — the app membership table remains the single authority source.
@ref LLP 0240#d2-compile-one-authority-ir-for-read-and-write-decisions
  — the projection references the shipped membership/policy IR.

history.description:
Optional bounded record-history policy. Absence disables product
history for this table; v1 deliberately has no unbounded spelling.

membership.description:
At most one `.membership()` declaration per table. Its presence turns
the table into a system-recognized role-per-resource membership table:
a closed role vocabulary, immutable `(principal, resource)` axes, a
generated true-unique index, and a host-enforced write contract.
Declaring it alongside a hand-written `permissionBacking`/
`permissionFields` is a typed manifest error — the derivation owns the
table.

@ref LLP 0056#declaring-a-membership-table — the membership declaration
  is the recognized shape; the derivation, not the app, owns the table.

permissionBacking.description:
This table contains facts that grant or revoke authority. This axis is
independent of query/result dependence and of function-level
`authorityIndependent` declarations.

@ref LLP 0053#two-orthogonal-declarations — permission-backing data is
  an explicit table property, not inferred from function reads.

permissionFields.description:
Optional narrowing for known updates. Inserts, deletes, and updates
with absent/empty/unknown changed-field metadata remain conservative.

searchIndexes.description:
Portable full-text indexes over this ordinary table. Search metadata is
table-local because source field/visibility validation and synchronous
maintenance are schema obligations, not function-handler conventions.

@ref LLP 0073#search-declarations — one versioned declaration owns the
complete portable index semantics and work bounds.

searchLiveLimits.description:
The one table-wide aggregate live-search subscription ceiling.
Optional because absence selects the target's admitted default; it is
table-scoped so indexes cannot publish conflicting aggregate answers.

@ref LLP 0136#capability-id-and-claim-discipline-llp-0119-oq2-proposal

vectorIndexes.description:
Portable exact-vector index declarations. A declaration is authoring
vocabulary, not support by itself: execution additionally requires a
target that reports qualified `vector_search_v1`.

@ref LLP 0132#index-declarations

visibility.description:
The table-wide default row-visibility declaration. Restricted leaves
and bounded owner-or-membership groups are compiled into ordinary
declarative query plans; public/implicit tables preserve legacy plan
bytes by carrying no executable predicate.

@ref LLP 0231#d1--the-table-is-the-policy-locus-queries-refine — the
  table policy is compiled into ordinary declarative query plans;
  arbitrary handler reads remain outside this bounded slice.

TableVisibilityArmV1.description: A disjunction arm deliberately excludes public-read and recursive groups.

TableVisibilityV1.description:
The closed table-policy language. This is intentionally separate from
search and asset-sharing visibility: extending this enum does not widen
either of those independently enforced surfaces.

TargetCapabilityId.description:
The exact target-capability vocabulary understood by paired-v1 manifests.
App artifacts retain string fields for v0 compatibility; every v1 string
is parsed through this enum before target support is consulted.

@ref LLP 0058#the-two-admissible-tuples — the v1 registry is closed and
LLP 0076 adds the ninth id with an exact positive runtime predicate.

oneOf.description:
Transactional one-off durable work, first slice (LLP 0070, Draft):
`ctx.jobs.enqueue` from JS mutations, the paved default queue,
job/attempt receipts, the declared job-status query, and the
injected-clock forced drain. Experimental for as long as LLP 0070 is
Draft — its claim boundary bars any durable-background-work
capability-class claim, and this id asserts current-contract
compatibility only.

The target atomically retains a client-mutation settlement under the
caller's replay-stable id and republishes it on duplicate delivery.
This is the safety prerequisite for a durable client outbox; it is
independent from merely accepting a `clientMutationId` field.

LLP 0157's mixed bounded-child/relational composite. Registration is
experimental and local-only; hosted, remote, and Cloudflare targets
retain explicit gaps until their own executors and evidence land.

First-page-only live search by bounded coarse re-execution. The id is
registered at experimental maturity but remains unsupported until the
complete LLP 0136 evidence/publication train lands.

Exact portable vector search. The local target publishes this at
experimental maturity only when its dedicated implementation fact and
complete closed profile are both present; every other target remains
a structured GAP.

Typed opaque structured stored values. The implementation carrier is
registered independently from target support so the eventual support
flip remains a separately reviewed LLP 0134 act.

Registry identity for the LLP 0162 `agentSafe.v1` extension/component
fact vocabulary. It does not name the `AgentSafeV1` core aggregate and
registration does not imply that any target has passed the corpus.

Additive LLP 0158 derived-deployment fork tuple. This identity remains
independent from both the storage extension and in-app branch facts.

fieldClassifications.description: Closed classification carrier for every participating source field.

VectorSearchFactsV1.description:
Closed facts vocabulary for exact target qualification. The qualified
local target publishes this block; other targets leave it absent and
report the `vector_search_v1` GAP.

description:
The public projection of [`InspectState`] served at the root `/inspect` and
`/`. It is a typed allowlist: the `From<InspectState>` below destructures the
full struct, so a newly-added `InspectState` (or `StorageInfo`,
`LiveSubscriptionInfo`) field is a compile error here rather than a silent
leak. Sensitive facts are deliberately dropped and live only in the gated
`/_snapback/api/inspect` twin: `subscriptions[].connection_id` (the
enumerate-and-disconnect vector — LLP 0031 D2/D3), the absolute
`storage.sqlite_path` and runtime executable/submodule paths (environment
leaks), per-room ephemeral identities, mutation-retention internals, and the
executable handler bodies inside `functions` (`IbexModule.source` /
`HandlerPlan` bodies — a source disclosure, ENG-23441; see
[`PublicFunctionManifest`]). Free-form diagnostic message/details and cron
run results are also gated because producers may include source paths or
application values.

@ref LLP 0031#resolved-decisions — D3: public `/inspect` is trimmed to an identity descriptor; the trim is guarded by a typed projection.
@ref LLP 0036#runtime-exposure-d5-d8 — secret-like runtime diagnostics are redacted before retention and never projected anonymously as raw text.
title: PublicInspect
